extracted text: The paper compares two alloys: the aluminum alloy 6061-T6 and a steel S25C. The 6061-T6 aluminum alloy is used to study plasticity-induced fatigue crack closure (PIFCC), while the steel S25C is used to study roughness-induced fatigue crack closure (RIFCC).

Tensile Strength (MPa) → UTS [MPa]
Elongation (pct) → elong [%]
